A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same BRIDGE research work. All 32 pages of each version, including equations, tables, figures and Appendices A–N, are available and support comparison.

before.justification: v4 reports original generation, forecasting, human-evaluation and ablation results in Section 5 and the appendices.

after.justification: v5 retains these original empirical results, with limited revisions to reported human-evaluation scores.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Appendix B retain the same multi-agent template refinement, semantic prototypes, text conditioning, diffusion objective and training/inference algorithms. Figure 2's revised labels do not establish a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both retain AirPassenger and Sunspots, the same 12 in-domain generation datasets, Stock and Web for unseen-domain evaluation, and ILI/M4 forecasting coverage, including the appendix evaluations.

E2.justification: Tabulated comparator identities are unchanged. Section 5.1.1 drops DDPM, which has no separately reported baseline scores in either PDF. Appendix H.1 also changes three ranked settings to four without identifying the fourth, leaving actual human-comparison membership uncertain.

E3.justification: Appendix H.1 changes the stated number of settings ranked in HE and HE@3 from three to four, retaining references to ground truth and three HE@3 distractors. This revises the documented evaluation protocol without establishing that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: Table 3 revises the Traffic human-evaluation evidence in the existing ablation testing text's contribution to controllability. The tested components and other text-type, agent-strategy, prototype-count, encoder and prototype-visualization analyses remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Table 1's uncertainty reporting, averaging across annotators, and Appendix M's t-tests and 1,000-resample OWA bootstrapping are unchanged. Table 14 retains the same significance-reporting practice and outcomes.

E6.justification: In Table 3, Traffic without text changes from 5.2 to 4.2 for HE and from 5.4 to 4.4 for HE@3. Other result entries are unchanged. The revised ranking-protocol description prevents treating these edits as established same-setting performance gains.

T1.justification: The problem formulation, diffusion loss, prototype-assignment and attention equations, and Appendix G metric definitions are retained. No mathematical assumption, derivation or proof is added or substantively revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same text-controlled generation, multi-agent dataset construction and hybrid prototype-conditioning contributions, including the claimed generation fidelity on 11 of 12 datasets.

C2.justification: Interpretations of text/prototype complementarity, concise descriptions, generalization and synthetic-data usefulness remain unchanged. No substantive limitation or applicability qualification is added; the discussion is not adjusted to reflect the revised Traffic scores.

D1.justification: Appendix F.1 removes the NN5 instruction that missing values were replaced by the median for the same weekday across the series. This reduces preprocessing documentation without establishing changed preprocessing. Hardware, training hyperparameters and the code-access link remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and research positioning are retained. The two Ho et al. 2020 bibliography entries are consolidated into one citation to the same work, rather than removing a distinct cited contribution.

P1.justification: v5 rewrites the Section 5 roadmap, corrects its reference to the agent-strategy section, adjusts affiliation wording, shortens dataset descriptions and cleans up duplicate bibliography information. The overall narrative and section organization remain stable.

P2.justification: Figure 2 is enlarged and replaces its specific metric list with time-series/text evaluation labels. Table 5's caption is corrected, Table 8 loses an appendix cross-reference, and appendix text reflows. Other figures and table structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v5 corrects Table 5's misleading caption and improves Figure 2's readability, but removes NN5 preprocessing instructions. The revised Traffic HE score also contradicts the retained claim of an increase exceeding three points: Table 3 now gives 4.2 minus 1.4, or 2.8. Together with the unexplained ranking-set revision, these mixed changes prevent a reliable overall improvement or deterioration judgment.
